en.title: Google Pixelsnap Phone Case Pixel 10 Pro Fold - Durable - Obsidian
bullets: The Pixelsnap Case for Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold works with magnetic technology; it features a sleek profile with drop-tested durability and wireless accessory compatibility[1]
The shock-absorbent case has been drop-tested for hundreds of hours to defend against everyday “oops” moments
It works with a variety of magnetic accessories, like chargers, grips, and stands, that you can easily snap on and off[1]
This phone case was designed for Pixel 10 Pro Fold, so it perfectly hugs every curve, folded or unfolded; choose a color that matches your phone, or switch it up for a look that’s all you

It’s mindfully made with you, your phone, and the planet in mind; a perfect fit ensures nothing gets in the way of seamless charging, audio clarity, or signal strength[2]; and the case is made from 52% recycled materials[3]
en.description: Protect your Pixel 10 Pro Fold with a custom-fit Google Pixelsnap Phone Case. Made with magnetic technology and drop-tested for hundreds of hours, this phone case is durable and stylish. And because it’s Pixelsnap compatible, you can use it with wireless chargers, stands, and other accessories.[1]

specs.Item Highlight: Durable protection, stain-resistant silicone, 52% recycled materials, made for wireless charging, drop-tested
